aggregation: Mean endpoint RMSE over initializations within room/regime; equal regimes within room; equal rooms. Whole-horizon RMSE is a separate flattened-target error. Skill uses the ratio of balanced normalized RMSE means.

diagnostic_labels.origin_outage: Sensor history contains an outage; not necessarily an outage exactly at issuance.
diagnostic_labels.target_outage: Target event time lies within the outage interval; scoring truth remains available offline.
diagnostic_labels.empty_groups: Null errors, zero contributing rooms, and zero labels are retained; whole-horizon subgroup diagnostics were not computed.

uncertainty: Paired whole-room percentile bootstrap; six-room synthetic precision is limited. Initialization SD is nested and is not an independent replication count.
verification_scope: Complete saved-summary identities, normalization, counts and aggregation; no independent prediction-array replay or building-population validation.

supplemental.scope: All model tests incl CUDA plus new analyzer tests; overlaps full suite

engineering.scope: Four new neural arms pass absolute gates but fail base-VM RMSE/MAE/MAPE regression; unvalidated. Ridge passes both. No gates or models retuned.
engineering.gpu_resident_context: Read-only process identity check found an existing marimo forecast_lab.py app, not another launched GPU study; local study fits serialized.
engineering.storage_recovery: No fit rerun; original pilot failed finalization retained separately; v1.1 changes JSON scalar serialization only.
